best_for: ApplicationWheel shows where one Purified Water package goes as an application wheel: the package in the hub inside its loop ring, one numbered segment per industry group round it, and each group's block (name and page link, limit tag, plant uses) beside its segment on a hairline leader.

block.intro: One Purified Water package, configured to each use, across all six. What changes is where the water goes and who writes its limit.
